summary: PowerShell calls now deny dynamic-execution commands and all unquoted script blocks while preserving bash and cmd command reading.
verified: vloop task gate T2 exited 0 and printed gate T2: pass (3.416s).
notes: The PowerShell deny check uses case-insensitive basenames and reports the original command token; parsed parenthesized commands are retained only to preserve an exact W2 denial over a later syntax refusal. Go tests cover all names and aliases, paths and .exe suffixes, separators, wrappers, parenthesized pipelines, script-block forms and bash/cmd non-regression.
